messages:
Amelia: Quick sync — we've got several customers asking for better request/response telemetry and a compact schema for chat+tool calls. want to align on naming + must-have launch criteria.
Jordan: +1. can we split into: 1) naming conventions, 2) token usage fields, 3) trace IDs, 4) rollout plan?
Amelia: yep. my proposal: minimal surface in v1 (nonbreaking): add response_metadata object with small fields; v2 adds richer per-token and tooling detail.
Sid: important: "response_metadata" vs "rsp_meta" — prefer readable long name for public API. shorter internal aliases ok.
Olivia: customers (enterprise) specifically asked for per-route cost attribution and a stable trace id to correlate billing -> model run.
Ravi: from infra: trace id needs to be deterministic and low-entropy (16-20 hex) so it fits logs and doesn't explode storage. suggest using `trace_id` as hex string, and `parent_trace` optional for tool calls.
Jordan: naming bikeshed: `request_id` already exists in some stacks. can we standardize on `trace_id` for cross-service and keep `request_id` for client-provided ids?
Sid: +1 to that. `trace_id` = system-generated, `client_request_id` optional. doc example to show both.
Amelia: token usage fields: customers want cost visibility without sending tokenized payloads. propose aggregated counts: `prompt_tokens`, `completion_tokens`, `total_tokens`. all ints.
Olivia: what about embeddings/rerank? rerank wants per-item token counts or that's too heavy?
Ravi: per-item for rerank could be expensive. we can add optional `item_token_counts` as an array but mark it opt-in behind a flag to avoid storage bloat.
Jordan: also need to support function/tool calls. proposal: add `tools` array in response_metadata with entries: `{name, status, trace_id, time_ms}`. small and composable.
Sid: please ensure `tools` entries reference parent `trace_id` for correlation. also include `tool_request_id` when available.
Amelia: launch criteria — must: schema stable for 3 weeks in beta, docs and SDKs updated, server-side routing emits `trace_id` end-to-end, backwards-compat no breaking changes for current clients.
Jordan: nice-to-have for GA: per-token breakdown per-model variant, `item_token_counts` for rerank, and sampling of token-level deltas for quality monitoring.
Olivia: ops: we need retention plan for response_metadata telemetry. default 30d for full detail, 90d aggregated. legal will want a knob to disable telemetry.
Ravi: infra notes: emitting these fields increases event size ~ 120-350 bytes. estimated extra S3/month ~ small for most, but enterprise could hit scale. we need quotas + opt-in.
Sid: migration: version header `x-rw-api-version: 2026-03-xx`. implement server fallback: if client doesn't accept new fields, we still return but under `response_metadata` subfield `experimental` for now.
Jordan: docs: include minimal examples for chat, embeddings, and rerank. show `trace_id` correlation across tool call example.
Amelia: stakeholder asks: Growth wants `prompt_tokens` surfaced for usage page; Sales wants an enterprise flag and SLA for telemetry retention.
Olivia: can we do a canary rollout: 5% of traffic with full `response_metadata`, 25% after 2 weeks, GA after 6 weeks if no regressions?
Ravi: deploy-bot: Canary rollout started: group=api-response-meta, pct=5%, ts=2165432200
Amelia: good. record follow-ups: (1) finalize field names by EOD, (2) draft docs + SDK changes, (3) define opt-in flag & retention defaults.
Jordan: I'll own the naming PR. will open RFC with examples + migration notes.
Sid: I'll prototype server side emission and a small sample exporter to show size impact.
Olivia: I'll coordinate with growth/sales for enterprise retention + billing UI.
Ravi: I'll add quota estimates and opt-in switch to infra backlog.
Amelia: thanks. if no objections by EOD we'll lock names and start RFC. :thumbsup:
Jordan: one tiny nit — use snake_case in JSON for fields (matches current SDKs).
Sid: agreed snake_case.
Olivia: linking a quick example payload for reference:
Olivia: ```
{
  "id": "resp_01Fxxx",
  "trace_id": "a3f5c2e7b8d1f4a0",
  "client_request_id": "cust-2345",
  "response_metadata": {
    "prompt_tokens": 42,
    "completion_tokens": 120,
    "total_tokens": 162,
    "tools": [ { "name": "search", "status": "ok", "trace_id": "a3f5c2e7b8d1f4b1", "time_ms": 120 } ]
  },
  "output": { "type": "chat", "text": "..." }
}
```
Amelia: great example. keep it small. we'll publish RFC + timeline tomorrow.
Ravi: deploy-bot: Canary update: group=api-response-meta, pct=25%, ts=2165432300
Amelia: end of thread — thanks all.
